message: The aspect weaver '{0}' is provided by two different assemblies: '{1}' and '{2}'. This typically happens when two versions of the same aspect library are referenced, for instance through a package and through a project reference. Remove one of the conflicting references.
rationale: The diagnostic is an error, so the build fails; the sentence 'Metalama will use the weaver from '{1}'' suggests that the situation is harmless. The added example of two routes (package and project reference) is the typical cause named at the report site in AspectDriverFactory (issue #1743).
